bullets.text: iOS 26 Maps Upgrade - Enhanced search functionality now powered by **Apple Intelligence** for smarter navigation.
Disable iPhone Tracking - **Apple**'s new 'Visited Places' feature can be turned off for privacy.
UK Government's Backdoor Demand - The British government continues to push **Apple** for iCloud access, raising privacy concerns.
Apple Glasses Rumors - Anticipated **Apple Glasses** may feature AI capabilities without a display.
OpenAI's Sora App Success - **Sora** reaches No. 1 on the US App Store, showcasing demand for AI video tools.
Live Translation for AirPods - New **Live Translation** feature available for older AirPods models with iOS 26.
Unity Security Alert - **Unity** warns developers to update games due to a significant security vulnerability.
Snapchat Storage Fees - **Snapchat** introduces paid storage plans for Memories, capping free storage at 5GB.
